verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents AI-driven browser agents that run autonomously in managed cloud sessions, started with a single API call and executed without local infrastructure. Built-in agents include Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, BrowserUse and HyperAgent, so tasks do run in the background on its cloud. However, there is no evidence of a way to *set up* standing automations: no scheduling, recurring runs, triggers, or completion notifications. Each run appears to be invoked on demand by the user's own code. missing for 10: scheduled/recurring automation setup, event triggers, background job management or completion callbacks, independent hands-on corroboration of unattended runs.
